visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a handheld camera following a woman with short black hair and glasses wearing a khaki school uniform as she slides open a white slatted door and enters a bright classroom. A man in a similar khaki uniform follows her, holding a gimbal camera. Yellow text overlays the screen. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a classroom with many students in khaki uniforms sitting at wooden desks. A male teacher in a pink shirt stands at the front by a chalkboard. Gai Rui and Ni are seated at the back, smiling and whispering to each other. (3) During a group discussion phase, the camera captures close-up shots of Gai Rui and Ni interacting with a male student. They are looking at papers on a desk. The lighting is bright and natural from the classroom windows. (4) The duo is now standing at the front of the classroom next to the teacher and another student. The chalkboard behind them is covered in handwritten text. One student holds a large white dice with black dots. Ni holds a stack of papers and gestures as she speaks. (5) The final sequence shows the man and woman in a hallway outside the classroom, laughing and talking. They both wear black digital watches. The background consists of grey concrete walls and lockers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp sound of a sliding door followed by a high-pitched male voice lecturing in a professional narrative tone. Background classroom chatter is low. (2) Upbeat, medium-tempo electronic BGM fades in. A female voice with high pitch variability reacts with surprise. A male voice laughs. (3) A series of rapid 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects punctuate jump cuts between different student conversations. (4) A loud, echoing 'ding' heralds a public broadcast speaker with a deep, authoritative male voice. The BGM ducks in volume while the announcer speaks. (5) Fast-paced conversation returns as the BGM swells in volume. Multiple voices overlap with laughter and short, percussive sound effects.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is an entertainment-focused vlog where the creators infiltrate a high-stakes academic environment (Chien Kuo High School) to observe and participate in current educational methods. It uses humor and high-energy editing to contrast the creators' past experiences with the students' modern classroom reality.
